zstd-wasm (vendored build from the npm package)
===============================================

name:        @bokuweb/zstd-wasm
version:     0.0.27
source:      https://github.com/bokuweb/zstd-wasm
license:     MIT
copyright:   bokuweb (the npm package and the JavaScript glue)

The JavaScript/WebAssembly port embeds Facebook's zstd library
(https://github.com/facebook/zstd — BSD dual-licensed, see its LICENSE)
compiled with Emscripten. The .wasm binary and the JS glue in this
directory are copied verbatim from the published npm package
"@bokuweb/zstd-wasm@0.0.27" (dist/esm) with exactly one mechanical change:
relative import specifiers gained explicit ".js" extensions so the files
load as native browser ES modules (no logic, names, or values changed).

Vendored for use by layerscope (MIT) so browsers whose
DecompressionStream lacks 'zstd' can still read zstd-compressed
image layers locally, with no network fetch beyond the app's own
static assets.
